# dsh CLI 动词与参数

> 来源 commit `687f282e8625`（版本 `0.2.1-rc.2`，提交于 2026-10-17）。本表由脚本从源码抽取；升级 harness 时重跑 `node tools/gen-harness-facts.mjs` 并 diff。

来源：`apps/cli/src/args.ts`、`apps/cli/src/plugin.ts`。

## 用法示例（源码 help 原文）

```
dsh web                                   boot the web profile (same as: dsh --profile web)
dsh rescue --from-default-profile web
dsh headless "run the tests"              answer one task, print the result, and exit
dsh tui --patch ./extra.yml               boot a custom profile with one extra overlay
dsh tui --resume <session>                arguments after the launcher flags reach the app
dsh web --help                            the web app's own flags and help
dsh plugin --profile tui add <package>    install a plugin into the tui profile
```

## 启动器选项

| flag | help |
|---|---|
| `--profile <name>` | the profile under $DSH_HOME/profiles to boot |
| `--from-default-profile <name>` | replace a custom profile with a fresh copy of a shipped profile template |
| `--patch <path>` | extra patch-list overlay applied after the profile layer (repeatable) |
| `--dump-config` | print the composed profile tree and exit |
| `--dump-config-schema` | print JSON Schema for profile entries and patches without mounting |
| `--dump-default-config` | print the profile tree without its user layer or --patch overlays and exit |

必填：`--profile <name> is required`

## `dsh plugin`（源码头注释原文）

> Run package management for a profile.
> @param profile Profile name; Desktop's reserved profile must already be initialized by the application.
> @param args DSH exemption command or pnpm arguments relative to the invoking directory.
> @param packageManager Installation-owned executable and environment for pnpm operations.
> @returns Zero on success; nonzero on invalid approval or package-manager failure.

- 因此正确写法是 `dsh plugin --profile <name> add <package-or-abs-path>` / `remove` / `update`；**没有** `dsh plugin install`、`dsh plugin check`、`dsh doctor`。
- 本地验证：`dsh --profile <name> --dump-config` 应能看到 bundle 的行。
